import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from controller import Controller  # Assuming the controller logic is in a module named 'controller'

class TestController(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.controller = Controller()

    @patch('controller.Controller.get_measured_pressure')
    def test_meet_commanded_pressure_within_overshoot(self, mock_get_measured_pressure):
        # Given
        commanded_pressure = 10  # Example commanded pressure
        PEEP = 5  # Example PEEP value
        overshoot_limit = 0.8 * PEEP - 1  # Calculated overshoot limit
        mock_get_measured_pressure.return_value = commanded_pressure + overshoot_limit - 0.1  # Slightly within limit

        # When
        self.controller.set_commanded_pressure(commanded_pressure)
        self.controller.set_PEEP(PEEP)
        self.controller.pressure_fall_phase()

        # Then
        self.assertTrue(mock_get_measured_pressure.return_value <= commanded_pressure + overshoot_limit)

    @patch('controller.Controller.get_measured_PEEP')
    def test_meet_commanded_PEEP_within_tolerance(self, mock_get_measured_PEEP):
        # Given
        commanded_PEEP = 10  # Example commanded PEEP
        tolerance = 1 + 0.1 * commanded_PEEP  # Calculated tolerance
        mock_get_measured_PEEP.return_value = commanded_PEEP + tolerance - 0.1  # Slightly within limit

        # When
        self.controller.set_commanded_PEEP(commanded_PEEP)
        self.controller.apply_PEEP()

        # Then
        self.assertTrue(mock_get_measured_PEEP.return_value <= commanded_PEEP + tolerance)

    @patch('controller.Controller.get_measured_FiO2')
    def test_achieve_target_FiO2_within_tolerance(self, mock_get_measured_FiO2):
        # Given
        target_FiO2 = 0.21  # Example target FiO2
        tolerance = 0.05  # Tolerance as specified
        mock_get_measured_FiO2.return_value = target_FiO2 + tolerance - 0.01  # Slightly within limit

        # When
        self.controller.set_target_FiO2(target_FiO2)
        self.controller.adjust_FiO2()

        # Then
        self.assertTrue(mock_get_measured_FiO2.return_value <= target_FiO2 + tolerance)

    @patch('controller.Controller.get_measured_FiO2')
    def test_report_measured_FiO2_before_patient_inhale(self, mock_get_measured_FiO2):
        # Given
        mock_get_measured_FiO2.return_value = 0.21  # Example measured FiO2

        # When
        measured_FiO2 = self.controller.report_measured_FiO2()

        # Then
        self.assertEqual(measured_FiO2, mock_get_measured_FiO2.return_value)

    @patch('controller.Controller.adjust_for_air_conditions')
    def test_achieve_commanded_values_under_different_air_conditions(self, mock_adjust_for_air_conditions):
        # Given
        commanded_values = {'pressure': 10, 'PEEP': 5, 'FiO2': 0.21}
        mock_adjust_for_air_conditions.return_value = commanded_values  # Assuming adjustment returns the same values

        # When
        self.controller.set_commanded_values(commanded_values)
        adjusted_values = self.controller.adjust_for_air_conditions()

        # Then
        self.assertEqual(adjusted_values, commanded_values)

    @patch('controller.Controller.detect_patient_inspiration')
    def test_assist_control_with_pressure_controlled_ventilation_mode(self, mock_detect_patient_inspiration):
        # Given
        mock_detect_patient_inspiration.return_value = True  # Simulate patient inspiration detected

        # When
        inspiration_detected = self.controller.detect_patient_inspiration()

        # Then
        self.assertTrue(inspiration_detected)

    @patch('controller.Controller.handle_command')
    def test_safety_measures_for_absurd_commands(self, mock_handle_command):
        # Given
        absurd_command = {'pressure': 1000, 'PEEP': 1000, 'FiO2': 2}  # Clearly absurd command
        mock_handle_command.side_effect = ValueError("Invalid command values")

        # When / Then
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.controller.handle_command(absurd_command)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
